name: pgood
description: PGOOD assertion with stable_for_s=50µs filter. VIN steps from 0V to 5V at t=100µs. PG should stay LOW while VIN is below threshold, transition HIGH some time after VIN crosses 4V (the filter adds ~50µs of lag). Layer-5c voltage_gated_by_input topology.

expected.rationale: VIN=0V initially → far below 4V threshold → PG LOW.
Still before VIN step → PG LOW.
VIN stepped up at 100µs; after ~50µs filter delay the LP output crosses 4V and PG asserts. By 400µs (3-4 time-constants later) PG has fully asserted.
